verses.original: דְבַר־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וַיְהִ֥י לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יִשְׂרָאֵל֩ וַיֵּצֵ֣א לִקְרַ֨את פְּלִשְׁתִּ֜ים לַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ עַל־ הָאֶ֣בֶן הָעֵ֔זֶר וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים חָנ֥וּ בַאֲפֵֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ḏə·ḇar- šə·mū·’êl way·hî lə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·ṣê liq·raṯ pə·liš·tîm lam·mil·ḥā·māh way·ya·ḥă·nū ‘al- hā·’e·ḇen hā·‘ê·zer ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm ḥā·nū ḇa·’ă·p̄êq
verses.literal: Thus the word of Samuel came to all Israel Now the Israelites went out to meet the Philistines in battle and camped at vvv Ebenezer while the Philistines camped at Aphek

verses.original: פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים וַיַּעַרְכ֨וּ לִקְרַ֣את יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַתִּטֹּשׁ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיִּנָּ֥גֶף לִפְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּכּ֤וּ כְּאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִֽישׁ׃ בַמַּֽעֲרָכָה֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה
verses.transliteration: p̄ə·liš·tîm way·ya·‘ar·ḵū liq·raṯ yiś·rā·’êl ham·mil·ḥā·māh wat·tiṭ·ṭōš yiś·rā·’êl way·yin·nā·ḡep̄ lip̄·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yak·kū kə·’ar·ba·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’îš ḇam·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: The Philistines arrayed themselves against Israel and as the battle spread Israel was defeated by the Philistines who struck down about four thousand men on the battlefield . . .

verses.original: הָעָם֮ וַיָּבֹ֣א אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה֒ זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ לָ֣מָּה יְהוָ֛ה נְגָפָ֧נוּ לִפְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים הַיּ֖וֹם נִקְחָ֧ה אֵלֵ֣ינוּ אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה מִשִּׁלֹ֗ה אֶת־ וְיָבֹ֣א בְקִרְבֵּ֔נוּ וְיֹשִׁעֵ֖נוּ מִכַּ֥ף אֹיְבֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām way·yā·ḇō ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mə·rū lām·māh Yah·weh nə·ḡā·p̄ā·nū lip̄·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm hay·yō·wm niq·ḥāh ’ê·lê·nū ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ Yah·weh miš·ši·lōh ’eṯ- wə·yā·ḇō ḇə·qir·bê·nū wə·yō·ši·‘ê·nū mik·kap̄ ’ō·yə·ḇê·nū
verses.literal: When the troops returned to the camp the elders of Israel asked Why has the LORD brought defeat on us before the Philistines today Let us bring . . . the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Shiloh - so that it may go with us to save us from the hand of our enemies

verses.original: הָעָם֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח שִׁלֹ֔ה וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ מִשָּׁ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַכְּרֻבִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עֵלִ֗י חָפְנִ֖י וּפִֽינְחָֽס׃ וְשָׁ֞ם עִם־ אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām way·yiš·laḥ ši·lōh way·yiś·’ū miš·šām ’êṯ ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yō·šêḇ hak·kə·ru·ḇîm šə·nê ḇə·nê- ‘ê·lî ḥā·p̄ə·nî ū·p̄î·nə·ḥās wə·šām ‘im- ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: So the people sent [men] to Shiloh and they brought back - the ark of the covenant of the LORD of Hosts who sits enthroned between the cherubim And the two sons of Eli Hophni and Phinehas were there with the ark of the covenant of God

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָה֙ כְּב֨וֹא אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל גְדוֹלָ֑ה תְּרוּעָ֣ה וַיָּרִ֥עוּ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ וַתֵּהֹ֖ם
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh kə·ḇō·w ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh tə·rū·‘āh way·yā·ri·‘ū hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tê·hōm
verses.literal: When the ark of the covenant of the LORD entered . . . the camp all the Israelites raised such a great shout that the ground shook

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֤וּ ק֣וֹל הַתְּרוּעָ֔ה פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ אֶת־ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֶ֠ה ק֣וֹל הַזֹּ֖את הַגְּדוֹלָ֛ה הַתְּרוּעָ֧ה בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה הָעִבְרִ֑ים וַיֵּ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֚י אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה בָּ֖א אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū qō·wl hat·tə·rū·‘āh p̄ə·liš·tîm ’eṯ- way·yō·mə·rū meh qō·wl haz·zōṯ hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh hat·tə·rū·‘āh bə·ma·ḥă·nêh hā·‘iḇ·rîm way·yê·ḏə·‘ū kî ’ă·rō·wn Yah·weh bā ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: On hearing the noise of the shout the Philistines - asked What is . . . this loud shouting in the camp of the Hebrews And when they realized that the ark of the LORD had entered . . . the camp

verses.original: הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיִּֽרְאוּ֙ כִּ֣י אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּ֥א אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיֹּאמְרוּ֙ אָמְר֔וּ א֣וֹי לָ֔נוּ כִּ֣י לֹ֥א כָּזֹ֖את הָיְתָ֛ה אֶתְמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֹֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: hap·pə·liš·tîm way·yir·’ū kî ’ĕ·lō·hîm bā ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yō·mə·rū ’ā·mə·rū ’ō·w lā·nū kî lō kā·zōṯ hā·yə·ṯāh ’eṯ·mō·wl šil·šōm
verses.literal: the Philistines were afraid - The gods have entered . . . their camp . . . they said Woe to us for nothing like this has happened before . . .

verses.original: א֣וֹי לָ֔נוּ מִ֣י יַצִּילֵ֔נוּ מִיַּ֛ד הָאֵ֑לֶּה הָאַדִּירִ֖ים הָאֱלֹהִ֥ים אֵ֧לֶּה הֵ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים הַמַּכִּ֧ים אֶת־ מִצְרַ֛יִם בְּכָל־ מַכָּ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w lā·nū mî yaṣ·ṣî·lê·nū mî·yaḏ hā·’êl·leh hā·’ad·dî·rîm hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’êl·leh hêm hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ham·mak·kîm ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim bə·ḵāl mak·kāh bam·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: Woe to us Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods These . . . are the gods who struck - the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness

verses.original: הִֽתְחַזְּק֞וּ וִֽהְי֤וּ לַֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים פֶּ֚ן תַּעַבְד֣וּ לָעִבְרִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָבְד֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם לַאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וְנִלְחַמְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hiṯ·ḥaz·zə·qū wih·yū la·’ă·nā·šîm pə·liš·tîm pen ta·‘aḇ·ḏū lā·‘iḇ·rîm ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇə·ḏū lā·ḵem wih·yî·ṯem la·’ă·nā·šîm wə·nil·ḥam·tem
verses.literal: Take courage and be men O Philistines Otherwise you will serve the Hebrews just as they served you Now be men and fight

verses.original: פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּלָּחֲמ֣וּ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּנָּ֤גֶף אִ֣ישׁ וַיָּנֻ֙סוּ֙ לְאֹהָלָ֔יו הַמַּכָּ֖ה וַתְּהִ֥י מְאֹ֑ד גְּדוֹלָ֣ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף רַגְלִֽי׃ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּפֹּל֙
verses.transliteration: p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū yiś·rā·’êl way·yin·nā·ḡep̄ ’îš way·yā·nu·sū lə·’ō·hā·lāw ham·mak·kāh wat·tə·hî mə·’ōḏ gə·ḏō·w·lāh šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ raḡ·lî mî·yiś·rā·’êl way·yip·pōl
verses.literal: So the Philistines fought and Israel was defeated and each man fled to his tent The slaughter was very great thirty thousand foot soldiers of Israel fell

verses.original: וַאֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהִ֖ים נִלְקָ֑ח עֵלִי֙ וּשְׁנֵ֤י בְנֵֽי־ חָפְנִ֖י וּפִֽינְחָֽס׃ מֵ֔תוּ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·rō·wn ’ĕ·lō·hîm nil·qāḥ ‘ê·lî ū·šə·nê ḇə·nê- ḥā·p̄ə·nî ū·p̄î·nə·ḥās mê·ṯū
verses.literal: The ark of God was captured and Eli’s two sons Hophni and Phinehas died

verses.original: הַה֑וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם בִּנְיָמִן֙ אִישׁ־ וַיָּ֤רָץ מֵהַמַּ֣עֲרָכָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֥א שִׁלֹ֖ה וּמַדָּ֣יו קְרֻעִ֔ים וַאֲדָמָ֖ה עַל־ רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm bin·yā·min ’îš- way·yā·rāṣ mê·ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh way·yā·ḇō ši·lōh ū·mad·dāw qə·ru·‘îm wa·’ă·ḏā·māh ‘al- rō·šōw
verses.literal: That same day a Benjamite . . . ran from the battle line all the way to Shiloh with his clothes torn and dirt on his head

verses.original: וַיָּב֗וֹא וְהִנֵּ֣ה עֵ֠לִי יֹשֵׁ֨ב עַֽל־ הַכִּסֵּ֜א יַךְ דֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ מְצַפֶּ֔ה כִּֽי־ לִבּוֹ֙ הָיָ֤ה חָרֵ֔ד עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְהָאִ֗ישׁ בָּ֚א בָּעִ֔יר לְהַגִּ֣יד כָּל־ הָעִֽיר׃ וַתִּזְעַ֖ק
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w wə·hin·nêh ‘ê·lî yō·šêḇ ‘al- hak·kis·sê yaḵ de·reḵ mə·ṣap·peh kî- lib·bōw hā·yāh ḥā·rêḏ ‘al ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·hā·’îš bā bā·‘îr lə·hag·gîḏ kāl- hā·‘îr wat·tiz·‘aq
verses.literal: When he arrived there was Eli sitting on his chair beside the road [and] watching because his heart vvv trembled for the ark of God When the man entered the city to give a report the whole city cried out

verses.original: עֵלִי֙ אֶת־ וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל הַצְּעָקָ֔ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מֶ֛ה ק֥וֹל הַזֶּ֑ה הֶהָמ֖וֹן וְהָאִ֣ישׁ מִהַ֔ר וַיָּבֹ֖א וַיַּגֵּ֥ד לְעֵלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·lî ’eṯ- way·yiš·ma‘ qō·wl haṣ·ṣə·‘ā·qāh way·yō·mer meh qō·wl haz·zeh he·hā·mō·wn wə·hā·’îš mi·har way·yā·ḇō way·yag·gêḏ lə·‘ê·lî
verses.literal: Eli - heard the outcry . . . and asked Why . . . this commotion So the man hurried over . . . and reported to Eli

verses.original: וְעֵלִ֕י תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֑ה וְעֵינָ֣יו קָ֔מָה וְלֹ֥א יָכ֖וֹל לִרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ê·lî tiš·‘îm ū·šə·mō·neh ben- šā·nāh wə·‘ê·nāw qā·māh wə·lō yā·ḵō·wl lir·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Now Eli was ninety-eight . . . years old . . . and his gaze was fixed because he could not . . . see

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ הַבָּ֣א מִן־ הַמַּעֲרָכָ֔ה הָאִ֜ישׁ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ עֵלִ֗י וַאֲנִ֕י נַ֣סְתִּי מִן־ הַמַּעֲרָכָ֖ה הַיּ֑וֹם מֶֽה־ הָיָ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּנִֽי׃ וַיֹּ֛אמֶר
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî hab·bā min- ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh hā·’îš way·yō·mer ’el- ‘ê·lî wa·’ă·nî nas·tî min- ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵāh hay·yō·wm meh- hā·yāh had·dā·ḇār bə·nî way·yō·mer
verses.literal: I have just come from the battle the man said to Eli I fled from there today . . . What happened . . . my son Eli asked

verses.original: הַֽמְבַשֵּׂ֜ר וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַיַּ֨עַן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נָ֤ס לִפְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְגַ֛ם הָיְתָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה מַגֵּפָ֥ה בָעָ֑ם וְגַם־ שְׁנֵ֨י בָנֶ֜יךָ חָפְנִי֙ וּפִ֣ינְחָ֔ס מֵ֗תוּ וַאֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים נִלְקָֽחָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ham·ḇaś·śêr way·yō·mer way·ya·‘an yiś·rā·’êl nās lip̄·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm wə·ḡam hā·yə·ṯāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh mag·gê·p̄āh ḇā·‘ām wə·ḡam- šə·nê ḇā·ne·ḵā ḥā·p̄ə·nî ū·p̄î·nə·ḥās mê·ṯū wa·’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm nil·qā·ḥāh
verses.literal: The messenger . . . answered Israel has fled before the Philistines and there has been a great slaughter among the people . . . Your two sons Hophni and Phinehas are both dead and the ark of God has been captured

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים כְּהַזְכִּיר֣וֹ׀ וַיִּפֹּ֣ל אֲחֹ֨רַנִּ֜ית בְּעַ֣ד׀ מֵֽעַל־ הַ֠כִּסֵּא יַ֣ד הַשַּׁ֗עַר כִּֽי־ הָאִ֖ישׁ זָקֵ֥ן וְכָבֵ֑ד וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֤ר מַפְרַקְתּוֹ֙ וַיָּמֹ֔ת וְה֛וּא שָׁפַ֥ט אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm kə·haz·kî·rōw way·yip·pōl ’ă·ḥō·ran·nîṯ bə·‘aḏ mê·‘al- hak·kis·sê yaḏ haš·ša·‘ar kî- hā·’îš zā·qên wə·ḵā·ḇêḏ wat·tiš·šā·ḇêr map̄·raq·tōw way·yā·mōṯ wə·hū šā·p̄aṭ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh
verses.literal: As soon as - the ark of God was mentioned Eli fell backward . . . from his chair by the city gate and being - old and heavy he broke his neck and died And [Eli] had judged - Israel forty years

verses.original: וְכַלָּת֣וֹ אֵֽשֶׁת־ פִּינְחָס֮ הָרָ֣ה לָלַת֒ וַתִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֶת־ הַשְּׁמֻעָ֔ה אֶל־ הִלָּקַח֙ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲר֣וֹן וּמֵ֥ת חָמִ֖יהָ וְאִישָׁ֑הּ וַתִּכְרַ֣ע וַתֵּ֔לֶד כִּֽי־ צִרֶֽיהָ׃ נֶהֶפְכ֥וּ עָלֶ֖יהָ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵal·lā·ṯōw ’ê·šeṯ- pî·nə·ḥās hā·rāh lā·laṯ wat·tiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- haš·šə·mu·‘āh ’el- hil·lā·qaḥ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·rō·wn ū·mêṯ ḥā·mî·hā wə·’î·šāh wat·tiḵ·ra‘ wat·tê·leḏ kî- ṣi·re·hā ne·hep̄·ḵū ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: Now Eli’s daughter-in-law the wife of Phinehas was pregnant and about to give birth When she heard - the news of the capture of God’s ark and the deaths of her father-in-law and her husband she collapsed and gave birth for her labor pains overtook her

verses.original: וּכְעֵ֣ת מוּתָ֗הּ הַנִּצָּב֣וֹת עָלֶ֔יהָ וַתְּדַבֵּ֙רְנָה֙ אַל־ תִּֽירְאִ֖י כִּ֣י יָלָ֑דְתְּ בֵ֣ן וְלֹ֥א עָנְתָ֖ה וְלֹא־ שָׁ֥תָה לִבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·‘êṯ mū·ṯāh han·niṣ·ṣā·ḇō·wṯ ‘ā·le·hā wat·tə·ḏab·bê·rə·nāh ’al- tî·rə·’î kî yā·lā·ḏət ḇên wə·lō ‘ā·nə·ṯāh wə·lō- šā·ṯāh lib·bāh
verses.literal: As she was dying the women attending to her said Do not be afraid for you have given birth to a son But she did not respond . . . or pay any heed . . .

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָ֣א לַנַּ֗עַר אִֽי־ כָבוֹד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כָב֖וֹד גָּלָ֥ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶל־ אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים הִלָּקַח֙ וְאֶל־ חָמִ֖יהָ וְאִישָֽׁהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rā lan·na·‘ar ’î- ḵā·ḇō·wḏ lê·mōr ḵā·ḇō·wḏ gā·lāh mî·yiś·rā·’êl ’el- ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hil·lā·qaḥ wə·’el- ḥā·mî·hā wə·’î·šāh
verses.literal: And she named the boy vvv Ichabod saying The glory has departed from Israel because the ark of God had been captured [and] her father-in-law and her husband had been killed

verses.original: כָב֖וֹד גָּלָ֥ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַתֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֥י אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ נִלְקַ֖ח
verses.transliteration: ḵā·ḇō·wḏ gā·lāh mî·yiś·rā·’êl wat·tō·mer kî ’ă·rō·wn hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm nil·qaḥ
verses.literal: The glory has departed from Israel she said for the ark of God has been captured
